action.message:
Based on my research, I found clear evidence that Neil Patrick Harris has narrated the audiobook version of "Henry Huggins."

On the Amazon product page for "The Henry Huggins Audio Collection" (Audible Audio Edition), Neil Patrick Harris is listed as one of the narrators alongside William Roberts, published by HarperAudio [13]. Multiple reviews on Goodreads corroborate this, with readers specifically stating "Neil Patrick Harris knocks it out of the park with his narration" and "Neil Patrick Harris's narration was spot on" [14].

The answer is: Yes, Neil Patrick Harris has narrated the audiobook version of "Henry Huggins" - specifically, he narrated "The Henry Huggins Audio Collection" which is a collection of books by Beverly Cleary.
